subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage stack as the canonical future accounting architecture while retaining legacy authority until promotion evidence is explicitly approved?
rationale: The implementation is technically strong, but choosing a new accounting authority, promotion contract, and long-term maintenance architecture cannot be inferred from tests or aggregate accuracy alone.

options.title: Adopt as shadow-first architecture
options.body: Land the stack in order, keep legacy authoritative, and require a later explicit promotion decision after broader finalized-day validation.

options.title: Prefer the narrow fork fix
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 for the immediate overcount and defer the broader lineage architecture.

options.title: Pause the lineage stack
options.body: Keep the current scanner architecture and close or substantially narrow the stack if its long-term complexity is not worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Adopt as shadow-first architecture
recommendation.body: Land the stack in order, keep legacy authoritative, and require a later explicit promotion decision after broader finalized-day validation.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the clearest available owner for the canonical architecture and release-compatibility choice.
